meta.description: III International Conference on Literary and Film Tourism — Creative Economy, Innovation and Territorial Development. March 26-28, 2026 in Caxias do Sul/RS, Brazil

footer.aboutText: International event dedicated to literary and film tourism, exploring the creative economy and territorial development.

home.subtitle: Creative Economy, Innovation and Territorial Development
home.aboutText: The Graduate Program in Tourism and Hospitality (PPGTURH) and the Graduate Program in Letters and Culture (PPGLET), from the University of Caxias do Sul (Brazil), CETT Barcelona School of Tourism, Hospitality and Gastronomy - University of Barcelona (Spain), the School of Management, Hospitality and Tourism (Portugal) and the University of Groningen (Netherlands) are pleased to announce the III International Conference on Literary and Film Tourism, to be held in Caxias do Sul (Brazil) on March 26-28, 2026. The event brings together researchers, professionals and students interested in exploring the intersections between literature, cinema, tourism and territorial development. Focusing on the creative economy and innovation, it will be a space for debate and exchange of international experiences.

call.title: Call for Papers
call.description: Submit your research for presentation at the conference
call.guidelinesText: The III International Conference on Literary and Film Tourism explores the theme Creative Economy, Innovation and Territorial Development in the context of Literary Tourism and Film Tourism. We invite researchers, tourism professionals, managers, graduate and undergraduate students from different areas to present their research work. The instructions for participating are as follows:
call.individualDescription:
Instructions for Paper Submission

Dear candidate,

To submit your paper, please follow the instructions below carefully:

Thematic line number: Select the thematic line that best fits your proposal. This number must correspond to the theme of your work.

Paper title: Provide the complete title of your paper.

Abstract (up to 300 words): In the abstract field, include:

Paper title

Research objectives

Methodology used

Results obtained

Conclusions

Authors and affiliations: Provide the full names of all authors, including their institutional affiliations (university, company or institution).

References: List 3 to 5 bibliographic references used in preparing the paper.

Keywords: Choose 3 to 5 keywords that represent the content of your paper, separated by commas.

Language: Select the language in which your paper was written.

Attachments (optional): If desired, you can attach additional files, such as figures, tables or supplementary documents.

After completing the form and submitting, you will automatically receive a copy containing all the information that was submitted.

Important: Before submitting, review all fields to ensure that all information is correct and complete. Incomplete or non-standard papers may be disregarded.

venue.title: Event Venue
venue.description: Information about the location and how to get there
venue.ucsText: The conference will be held at the University of Caxias do Sul (UCS), one of the main higher education institutions in southern Brazil. The campus offers complete infrastructure for holding academic events.
venue.accommodationText: Caxias do Sul offers several accommodation options for all profiles. A list of partner hotels will be available soon.
venue.transportOption1Title: 1. Direct to the event city – Caxias do Sul RS
venue.transportOption1Text: The Hugo Cantergiani Regional Airport (CXJ) is the most practical way to get directly to Caxias do Sul. Located a few minutes from the city center and the University of Caxias do Sul (UCS), it receives daily flights from São Paulo (Congonhas and Guarulhos airports), operated by airlines such as Gol, Latam and Azul. This is the fastest and most convenient option for those seeking comfort and wishing to arrive directly at the conference destination.
venue.transportOption2Text: Salgado Filho International Airport (POA), located in Porto Alegre, capital of Rio Grande do Sul, is one of the main gateways for those traveling to Caxias do Sul. Located approximately 125 km from the city, the airport offers national and international connections, being a widely used alternative for conference participants. From there, you can continue to Caxias do Sul, the state's second largest city, by intercity bus, transfers, vans or car rental, on a route that combines practicality and beautiful landscapes of the Serra Gaúcha.
venue.hotelIntro: Make your stay easier during the event! (near UCS)
venue.hotelText: To make your experience even more pleasant, we recommend the Blue Tree Towers Hotel, which offers excellent infrastructure and various service categories to meet your needs. As the Official Hotel of our event, Blue Tree Towers provides comfort, convenience and quality, ensuring a pleasant stay.
venue.hotelCta: Contact the hotel directly and make your reservation to secure your accommodation. Don't miss the opportunity to stay in a strategic location, ideal for those attending our event.

villaDeiTroni.title: Villa Dei Troni
villaDeiTroni.description: The Conference closing will be a tour of the Largest Italian Immigration Theme Park in Brazil. Purchase your ticket.
villaDeiTroni.closingTour: The Conference closing, on the 28th, will be a tour of the Largest Italian Immigration Theme Park in Brazil!
villaDeiTroni.parkDescription: A little piece of Italy in southern Brazil. As you cross its gates, time slows down. Located in Caxias do Sul, in the charming historic neighborhood of Ana Rech, Villa dei Troni is the first Italian immigration theme park in Brazil. Amid 25 hectares of preserved nature and memory, visitors find a true 19th century imperial colony, with 40 original buildings and faithful replicas.
villaDeiTroni.parkDescription2: More than a historical rescue, Villa dei Troni is a place of belonging. Here, history is not just told, it is lived. Culture, leisure, gastronomy, history and contact with nature come together to create a unique experience — one that stays in memory and heart.
